notes.reproduction: All published leaf-level values (IoU, MAE, bias, QWK, Bland–Altman LoA) reproduced exactly at the printed precision for all six models before any figure was drawn (the script stops otherwise).
notes.figure4_label_fix: Rust UNet++ leaf IoU is 0.646541 (exact mean of 21 abaxial-face IoUs), which rounds to 0.647; the current figure4.png label 0.646 does not match the leaf-level mean (cause not traced).
notes.figure4_annotation: The 'n = ... test leaves' note of each Figure 4 panel is right-aligned to the right end of the drawn x-axis (checked in rendered coordinates), so it no longer extends past the axis.
notes.severity_labels: Figure 14 prints two severities per leaf, each labelled: the leaf severity (mean of the two faces; the value that sets the leaf's Figure 12 band and the value quoted in sentence 5) and the abaxial-face severity of the face shown. They differ, e.g. GX_246 reference 0.28% (leaf) vs 0.35% (abaxial face); GX_230 reference 3.92% (leaf) vs 4.33% (abaxial face); GX_007 reference 11.73% (leaf) vs 11.88% (abaxial face). Figure 13 prints the leaf severity, which for rust is by definition the abaxial-face severity (asserted equal). The printed leaf severities are asserted equal to the Figure 12 leaf table.
notes.healthy_leaves: Only 21 of the 54 healthy rust-pack test leaves (EARTH site) are available locally. None of Figures 4, 12, 13 or 14 uses healthy leaves: leaf IoU, as in the paper, is computed on the test leaves with disease (rust 21, leaf spot 55), so this local gap does not affect these figures.
notes.leaf_spot_face_rule: The requested rule 'face whose IoU is closest to the leaf mean' is degenerate: the leaf IoU is the mean of the two face IoUs, so both faces are exactly equidistant from it (asserted with exact fractions for the three selected leaves). A pre-specified, IoU-independent tie-break was used: the abaxial face (as for rust and for paper Figure 2). Both face IoUs are printed in Figure 14. Under an alternative reading (face closest to the disease-level mean 0.884) the faces would be abaxial, abaxial, adaxial (worst, median, best).
notes.extra_band: Bands 0.5–<2, 2–<5, 5–<20 and ≥20% were used as requested. One rust and six leaf-spot test leaves have reference severity <0.5%; they are shown as an additional '<0.5' band (the G0 range) so that every test leaf is counted (n sums to 21 and 55). Dropping that band leaves the other four bands unchanged. The six leaf-spot leaves below 0.5% all carry annotator grade G1 (the leaf-spot grade is visual).
notes.small_n: CIs are omitted for n < 3 (rust <0.5%: n = 1; leaf spot ≥20%: n = 2); no rust test leaf reached 20%. Percentile bootstrap CIs for bands with n = 5–6 rest on few distinct resamples (126 multisets for n = 5, 462 for n = 6) and are likely too narrow; treat per-band trends as descriptive.
notes.rust_reference: The rust reference masks are semi-automatic (colour detector + SAM 2, spot-checked, not edited), so rust FP/FN in Figure 13 and in the error-location summary are disagreements with that reference.
notes.cnn_protocol: Model contrasts compare the published single-run models, whose training protocols differ (CNNs: photometric jitter p = 0.8, 30 epochs, FP-penalised selection for rust). Matched retraining is in progress; Figures 4 and 12 will need regenerating with those models (% TODO(retraining)).
notes.test_leaves_shown: Figures 13 and 14 show three test leaves per disease, as the current Figures 9 and 10 already do. The data-availability statement says the held-out test set is withheld pending peer review; the author may wish to confirm that showing these six test scans is compatible with that.
notes.selection_unchanged: The selected leaves have leaf IoUs 0.638/0.767/0.857 (rust) and 0.732/0.904/0.961 (leaf spot), matching the values printed in the current figure9/figure10 to two decimals, so the leaf selection appears unchanged; the overlays are what was wrong (they are now registered).
notes.rendering: Qualitative panels are drawn in the 1024 x 1024 letterbox space; the PDF embeds the native pixels (interpolation 'none'), the 600 dpi PNG upsamples them with nearest neighbour. Outlines are vector 0.5-level contours of the binary masks with a thin dark halo.
notes.colours: Model colours/markers as specified. The disease colours of figure5 (rendered ≈ #CC7951 rust, ≈ #448BB0 leaf spot) are not used, because model is the encoded variable in these figures.
